mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane bag was most worthwhile: the picture showed how its wall separates an inside from an outside, giving the later fittings a clear place.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the two boundary proteins was clear but a little repetitive; both were direct fittings once their pictures showed where they belonged.

surprise.text: I was curious to see a copy of a DNA instruction leaving the nucleus through a pore; the chapter did not explain what happens to it next.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary. The pictures and goals made the pairings understandable, even though they did not explain every detail of how the parts work.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter because building the cell made its nested parts and routes clear, and I am curious what happens to the instruction copy. I would hope for more explanation and less repetitive fitting.
